randomization_contract.nominal_sampling: Select one complete measured row from the 50 ppm N group for the chosen cultivar. Preserve that row's height trajectory, stem cross-section, flower mass, and biomass together.
randomization_contract.healthy_envelope_sampling: For a broader but still evidence-linked envelope, select one complete row from the 50 or 150 ppm N groups for the chosen cultivar.
do_not_do: Do not draw every scalar independently from its marginal range; that destroys measured covariance.
Do not treat fertilizer-stressed plants as ordinary within-clone variation.
Do not infer branch topology, leaf attachment angles, tissue stiffness, cutting force, or contact damping from this scalar dataset.
randomization_contract.geometry_gap: The source supplies one frontal cultivar-by-treatment photo grid and scalar plant measurements, not 3D organ coordinates. A nominal graph must be traced from photographs or measured from partner plants.
randomization_contract.mechanics_gap: No flexural stiffness, damping, failure strain, petiole detachment force, or fresh-tissue mass distribution is reported. Those require separate literature priors and physical calibration tests.

secondary_datasets.name: Gill et al. industrial hemp phenotyping
secondary_datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 for tabular data; related time-series image archives are CC BY-NC 4.0
secondary_datasets.use: Daily side-view image sequences and plant-level projected shoot area through day 36; useful for early growth shape and within-genotype visual variation, not flowering architecture.

secondary_datasets.name: LAST-Straw
secondary_datasets.license: Not stated on the project page; verify before redistribution or product use.
secondary_datasets.use: Fourteen 3D point-cloud captures per plant over 11 weeks, with organ labels on 28 scans and stem-like skeletons. This is a stronger geometric template for cultivar-conditioned strawberry models than any open Cannabis dataset found in this pass.

limits: The five greenhouse cultivars were seed-grown, so within-cultivar spread includes sibling genetic variation as well as environmental and measurement variation.
The 50 ppm N nominal group contains at most six records per cultivar and some fields are missing. Empirical resampling is safer than fitting a high-dimensional Gaussian.
No open, cultivar-labeled, whole-plant 3D Cannabis time series was found in this search.
